title: What endoderm builds

objective.text: Name the organs that endoderm lines or builds.

body.general: What does the innermost germ layer, endoderm, become? It lines the gut [f1]. It also lines the airways [f2]. It lines the bladder and the tube that drains it, the urethra [f3]. It lines the middle-ear air space, the tympanic cavity, and the auditory tube that links it to the throat [f4]. It makes the working cells of the thyroid, parathyroids, liver and pancreas [f5]. It also forms the supporting framework of the tonsils and thymus [f6].
body.mbbs: Endoderm forms the epithelial lining of the gut tube [f1]. It lines the respiratory tract [f2]. It lines the urinary bladder and urethra [f3]. It lines the tympanic cavity and auditory tube [f4]. It forms the parenchyma of the thyroid, parathyroids, liver and pancreas [f5]. It forms the reticular stroma of the tonsils and thymus [f6]. The yolk sac, lined by endoderm, gives early nutrition [f7]. It makes the first, short-lived blood cells [f8]. Its back wall houses primordial germ cells before they migrate to the gonads [f9].

facts.text: Endoderm lines the urinary bladder and urethra.
Endoderm lines the tympanic cavity and auditory tube.
Endoderm forms the working cells (parenchyma) of the thyroid, parathyroids, liver and pancreas.
Endoderm forms the supporting framework (stroma) of the tonsils and thymus.
The yolk sac provides early nutrition.
The yolk sac makes the first, short-lived blood cells.
The back wall of the yolk sac houses primordial germ cells before they migrate to the gonads.
Definitive blood stem cells arise in mesoderm around the aorta, not in the yolk sac.

misconceptions.wrong: The bladder is mesoderm like the rest of the urogenital system.
misconceptions.right: Its lining is endoderm, from the cloaca; kidneys, gonads and ducts are mesoderm.

misconceptions.wrong: Blood stem cells come from the yolk sac.
misconceptions.right: The yolk sac makes the first short-lived blood cells; definitive stem cells arise around the aorta.

checks.prompt: Which of these is lined by endoderm?
checks.why: The bladder lining is endoderm; kidney tubules are mesoderm and the epidermis is ectoderm.

checks.prompt: In the liver and pancreas, what does endoderm form?
checks.why: Endoderm gives the parenchyma, the working cells; vessels and connective tissue come from mesoderm.

checks.prompt: Which part of the ear is lined by endoderm?
options: The skin of the outer ear
The tympanic cavity and auditory tube
checks.why: The middle-ear cavity and the auditory tube are endoderm-lined.

adult: In the adult, endoderm is the lining of the gut, airways and bladder [f1,f2,f3].

remember.q: Which glands get their working cells from endoderm?
Which ear spaces does endoderm line?
remember.a: The tympanic cavity and the auditory tube [f4].

remember.q: Where does the bladder lining come from?
